newsitem.title: USA: Apogee settles joint venture litigation.
newsitem.headline: Apogee settles joint venture litigation.

text.p: Apogee Enterprises Inc said Monday it has settled all claims with Marvin Lumber and Cedar Co with respect to Marcon Coating Inc and Viratec Thin Films Inc.
Apogee has agreed to pay $41 million to Marvin Lumber and Cedar Co on or before January 27, 1997 for their 50 percent interest in the businesses and certain leased assets, the company said.
The litigation resulted after Marvin Lumber and Cedar Co turned down Apogees offer for the remaining shares of the two joint ventures, glass products maker Apogee said.

Both parties have agreed to irrevocably release each other from all outstanding claims related to this litigation, other than certain trade accounts payable in the ordinary course of business, Apogee said.
Apogee shares closed up 1/4 at 40 Monday.
